lesson.intro: A verb is a doing or action word. It tells us what someone or something [[does]]. Every sentence needs a verb.
points: Action verbs: run, jump, eat, write, swim, read, cook.
Being verbs: [[am]], [[is]], [[are]] (now) and [[was]], [[were]] (past). I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are.
With he, she, it or one person/thing, add -s or -es to the verb: she [[sings]], he [[watches]], it [[flies]].
With I, you, we, they or many people/things, use the verb without -s: they [[sing]].
lesson.tip: To find the verb, ask: "What is someone doing?" or "What is happening?"
